subject: SDLC submission: consolidated CI/CD & secrets chain-of-custody for SIG intake
messages:
From: Alice Rivers <alice.rivers@finco.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Cc: audit@finco.com
Date: 2026-11-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: SDLC artifacts for SIG intake (FinCo)

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks again for taking this call with our intake team. As discussed, FinCo needs the following artifacts to complete our SIG intake and initial control mapping:

- CI/CD pipeline run logs showing PR->deploy for the last 60 days
- Code review matrix mapping PR IDs to reviewers and approvals
- Evidence of secrets handling (how secrets are provisioned to runners and rotated)
- Change management approval trail for production deploys

Can you provide a consolidated bundle and a short mapping doc that points our assessors to where each control is met? Ideally we can get an initial upload by EOD Wednesday so we can start the review.

If there are any items that are redacted or cannot be shared, please flag them and provide an alternate (e.g., audit logs, KMS rotation snapshots).

-Alice Rivers
Security Assessments Lead, FinCo
alice.rivers@finco.com

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Alice Rivers <alice.rivers@finco.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T11:48:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Request: SDLC artifacts for SIG intake (FinCo)

Hi Alice,

Thanks for the clear list — we can assemble that. Plan below:

1) CI/CD pipeline logs: we'll provide a tarball with authenticated pipeline run metadata (timestamps, job IDs, artifact hashes). That will include PR numbers and short job outputs; sensitive runner environment prints will be redacted.

2) Code review matrix: CSV mapping PR->author->reviewers->approval timestamp. We'll include our PR commit hashes in case you need provenance.

3) Secrets handling: we cannot share raw secrets. We'll provide KMS policy snapshots, our ephemeral secrets provisioning diagram, and an example runner token lifetime/rotation record.

4) Change approvals: a CSV export of our change-approval log (who approved, ticket link, timestamp) plus a short narrative describing emergency change exceptions.

Attachments I will upload to a shared Drive folder and send you the link. Monica (security) will attach the KMS snapshot and notes on HSM/KMS integration. Tessa will confirm the timeframe for the pipeline artifacts and help redact any PHI.

We expect to have the consolidated bundle ready for upload by 2026-11-03 EOD Pacific. If you need anything sooner for a high-priority control, tell me which control ID and we'll prioritize.

Regards,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive — Enterprise (Redwood Inference)
Phone: +1-415-555-0123

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T08:17:00-07:00
Subject: KMS & rotation evidence + notes for FinCo

Jasmine / Tessa,

I pulled the following evidence we should include in the FinCo bundle:

- kms_policy_snapshot_2026-10-30.pdf (exported RBAC and key rotation schedule)
- kms_audit_events_2026Q3.csv (truncated event IDs; full event hashes in secure logs)
- ephemeral_provision_flow.png (diagram with token minting flow for runners)

Notes:
- Our KMS is customer-managed for Private deployments; for hosted customers we use a multi-tenant HSM-backed key with strict access controls. For the SIG intake, include the policy snapshot and a statement of where master keys live (we cannot provide HSM console screenshots).
- For secrets rotation, provide a sample rotation log (date, key id, rotated_by). Full audit trail will be uploaded to your secure bucket if requested under an NDA addendum.

I also exported a change-approval CSV (change-approval-log_2026Q4.csv) that includes ticket ID, approver, approval timestamp, and brief justification. There are a handful of emergency changes with retroactive approvals; I'll flag those in the mapping doc.

-Monica Patel
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Alice Rivers <alice.rivers@finco.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Cc: audit@finco.com, security@finco.com
Date: 2026-11-02T17:03:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Request: SDLC artifacts for SIG intake (FinCo)

Thanks Jasmine / Monica — this is very helpful. A couple quick clarifications from the assessor team:

- For CI/CD logs we need evidence that PR gating jobs are enforced (e.g., tests required, approval counts). Can you map which pipeline steps correspond to gating policy IDs (FinCo will reference control: SIG-PR-01)?
- For code review CSV, can you include a column for the applied merge strategy and whether fast-forward merges are allowed?
- For KMS, the assessor asked whether key rotation is automated or manual and the SLA for rotation completion.

If you can add those small pieces to the mapping doc, we can proceed with an initial control mapping. We are ok with redacted fields as long as the redaction approach is called out.

Also we will need a formal delivery path — can you upload to the Drive folder and then share a one-time download link, or do you prefer us to retrieve from your secure S3 bucket? We have an intake ticket HS-987654321.

-Alice

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Alice Rivers <alice.rivers@finco.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-03T14:47:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Request: SDLC artifacts for SIG intake (FinCo)

Hi Alice — thanks, quick update: we uploaded an initial bundle to the Drive folder and set the link to expire in 14 days. The bundle includes:

- ci_pipeline_run_20261029.tar.gz (pipeline metadata + gating step map)
- code_review_matrix_2026-10.csv (includes merge strategy column and approval counts)
- kms_policy_snapshot_2026-10-30.pdf (policy + note on automated rotation)
- change-approval-log_2026Q4.csv (flagged emergency exceptions)
- mapping_doc_SIG_intake_2026-11-03.pdf (one-page control map referencing FinCo control IDs)

I answered your assessor questions in the mapping doc: gating job IDs are listed alongside the pipeline step names, merge strategy is in the CSV, rotation is automated for our hosted runners with a documented SLA of 24 hours for key rollover; manual rotation is permitted with multi-approver workflow and is noted where it applies.

Delivery path: we shared the Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cD_example_shared-evidence (one-time access disabled after expiry). If you need an S3 presigned URL instead, we can provision that — HS-987654321 will be the reference in the object metadata.

Next steps: let me know if the assessor needs raw audit streams for KMS events; Monica can provide a time-limited export under an NDA amendment. Otherwise we await your initial mapping feedback.

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive — Enterprise, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1-415-555-0123

Attachments: ci_pipeline_run_20261029.tar.gz; code_review_matrix_2026-10.csv; kms_policy_snapshot_2026-10-30.pdf; change-approval-log_2026Q4.csv
